events.description: Joey Tribbiani says Chandler Bing is going to pick one item from the options.
Chandler Bing says the item Joey Tribbiani just pointed at is patio furniture.
Joey Tribbiani says people are going to come in and think they are outside again.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani does not know about the birds design.
Joey Tribbiani says birds do not say to people, "Hello, sit here, eat something," and therefore do not invite people to sit and eat.
Chandler Bing says Joey Tribbiani is going to pick one item.
Chandler Bing tells Joey Tribbiani to forget about the bird design.
Chandler Bing says ladybugs, which are big red insects, suggest fine dining.
Joey Tribbiani says Chandler Bing wants to choose the bird design.
Joey Tribbiani tells Chandler Bing to get the bird design.
Chandler Bing says Kip would have liked the bird design.
